d: A Collection of Short Films Curated by Bizaar Studios, ranging from the comedic to horrific, find it all here.

st: A Wedding Dress Doesn't Suit Fujiko
d: Fujiko decides to marry Huffner for his jewelry collection, disregarding the rumor that Huffner's brides always die a mysterious death within a few weeks of their wedding.
Jigen receives a letter from Sister Angelica and heads to the African country of Borodias. Sister Angelica wants Jigen's help to rescue Dr. Othello, the leader of the country's independence movement.
The ICPO tries a different approach to capturing Lupin: astrology. It enlists the help of Marianne, a clairvoyant who can read Lupin's actions using astrological predictions and her crystal ball.
The president of Ichikawa Industries hires Kogoro to keep watch over both of his daughters who might attempt to murder him.
Conan, Ran and Kogoro are invited to the home of Kikuemon, a famous potter. Kikuemon claims to be a big fan of Kogoro and gifts him a valuable piece of pottery.
Kikuemon's daughter-in-law is found dead. Everyone thinks it's suicide due to her guilt of breaking a valuable piece, but Conan thinks it's a murder case.

st: The Memories of First Love Case (Part 1)
d: Conan, Ran and Sonoko are at Shinichi's place to help clean when they receive an unexpected visit from an upperclassmen who has come to visit Shinichi.

Meet Gerald and Helen Goode, a couple who live by the motto WWAGD ("What Would Al Gore Do?"). They're zealous vegans, they drive a hybrid, and they recycle everything possible. Even the family dog, Che, is vegan. Gerald pays for the family to adopt a highway, but picking up trash requires them to work with a gang of white supremacist prison inmates.
